{{Short description|British physicist}}
'''John Chalker''' is a British physicist. He taught at the [[University of Oxford]] and the [[Imperial College London]]. He won a [[Dirac Medal (IOP)|Dirac Medal]] in 2018 and a [[John William Strutt, Lord Rayleigh Medal and Prize]] in 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Paul Dirac Medal and Prize recipients {{!}} Institute of Physics |url=https://www.iop.org/about/awards/gold-medals/paul-dirac-medal-and-prize-recipients |access-date=2026-02-15 |website=www.iop.org |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=London |first=King's College |title=Maths Professor at King's awarded top Institute of Physics prize for theoretical physics |url=https://www.kcl.ac.uk/news/maths-professor-at-kings-awarded-top-institute-of-physics-prize-for-theoretical-physics |access-date=2026-02-15 |website=King's College London |language=en}}</ref>
